sn35.186:1.1: bhikkhave aniccaṃ atītaṃ || Sotaṃ || || Ghānaṃ || || Jivhā || || Kāyo || Mano anicco atīto || || 10
sn35.186:1.2: Evam passam bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmim pi nibbindati || sotasmim pi nibbindati || ghānasmim pi nibbindati || jivhāya pi nibbindati || kāyasmiṃ pi || manasmim pi nibbindati ||
sn35.186:1.3: nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati Vimuttasmi vimuttamhīti ñāṇaṃ hoti ||
sn35.186:1.4: Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyam kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || (20) Atītena 3-8 Cakkhum
